name: CM&F Group
one_liner: Professional liability insurance for nurses and nurse practitioners with specialty mental health coverage options.
short_description: CM&F Group provides professional liability insurance primarily for nurses and nurse practitioners, including psychiatric mental health nurse practitioners (PMHNPs) and other advanced practice provi...
long_description: CM&F Group has been providing professional liability insurance to nursing professionals for over 20 years. They specialize in coverage for nurses, nurse practitioners, clinical nurse specialists, and other advanced practice providers. For mental health, CM&F is particularly relevant for Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs) who need coverage for prescribing, psychotherapy, and psychiatric evaluation services. CM&F offers occurrence-based policies with limits up to $5M/$5M through A-rated carriers. Their policies include coverage for prescriptive authority, license defense, HIPAA violations, and telehealth services. CM&F offers competitive rates with discounts for claim-free history, professional association membership, and multi-year policies. They also provide entity coverage for NP-owned practices. The application process is online with instant quotes available for most practitioners.

pricing.notes: Rates vary by specialty, state, coverage limits, and practice setting. PMHNPs may pay more due to prescriptive authority. Discounts available for claims-free history and association membership.

compliance.notes: Insurance provider - HIPAA not applicable. Policies underwritten by A-rated insurance carriers.

faqs.q: Does CM&F cover psychiatric nurse practitioners?
faqs.a: Yes, CM&F Group provides professional liability coverage for Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioners (PMHNPs), including coverage for prescriptive authority and psychotherapy services.
Yes, CM&F policies include coverage for prescriptive authority, including controlled substance prescribing for PMHNPs and other NPs with prescribing privileges.

faqs.q: How much does PMHNP malpractice insurance cost?
faqs.a: CM&F rates for PMHNPs typically range from $600-1,200/year for full-time practitioners with $1M/$6M coverage, varying by state and practice setting.

faqs.q: Does CM&F cover telehealth psychiatric services?
faqs.a: Yes, CM&F policies include coverage for telehealth and telepsychiatry services provided by covered nurse practitioners.

company_info.notes: CM&F Group specializes in professional liability insurance for nursing professionals, with particular expertise in advanced practice providers including PMHNPs.
